title: mcp-server conformance case
description: One conversation with the conformance fixture server of mcp-server.md §9. `kind` selects how the client's side is given: `exchange` as parsed JSON-RPC messages, `stdio` as the raw chunks written to the server's input. `expect` is the exact list of messages the server sends, in order. Each branch requires its own input AND forbids the other kind's.

server.description: How the fixture server differs from §9's default. Absent: it serves the legacy era and has no instructions.

legacy.description: `reject`: the server refuses the legacy era (§3).

concurrent.description: exchange: every message is delivered before any is awaited. Without it each message is fully handled before the next is delivered. Needed for a cancellation, whose call never finishes by itself.

messages.description: exchange: the client's messages, in order. Any JSON value: a case may send what is not a JSON-RPC message at all.

chunks.description: stdio: the strings written to the server's input, one read each. A message boundary is a newline, wherever the chunk boundaries fall.

expect.description: The messages the server sends, in order. An error carries `message` only for code -32022 (§8, §9).
